title: Act: Add createRound client and Create round button sending the duration
summary: Post duration in hours to the admin create endpoint
description: Add createRound and a button in AdminApp using durationHours.
acceptance_criteria: createRound POSTs world_id and duration to /api/v1/admin/rounds.
Button triggers it, reloads current round, 401 returns to gate.

steps.action: Add exported createRound(token, durationHours) that calls adminRequest<Round>(token, '/api/v1/admin/rounds', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({world_id: WORLD_ID, duration: `${durationHours}h`})}), placed after closeRound.
steps.expected: Calling it POSTs the expected JSON with the Bearer header.

steps.action: Import createRound; add async function handleCreateRound() that try { const created = await createRound(token, durationHours); setRoundId(created.id); setReloads(n => n + 1); } catch (err) { handleError(err); }; add <button type="button" onClick={handleCreateRound}>Create round</button> before the Open round button.
steps.expected: Clicking Create round sends the POST with the entered hours.
